info.title: StreamCentral
info.description: StreamCentral is a backend project for a video hosting platform. It is built with Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and other tools. It supports features like user authentication, video uploads, likes, comments, playlists and subscriptions. It follows best practices for security and uses token-based authentication with JWT and password hashing with bcrypt.

tags.name: User
tags.description: The **User folder** contains endpoints for user-related functionalities like **signup**, **login**, and **profile management**. It handles secure user authentication using JWT and password hashing (bcrypt). The routes support creating and updating user accounts, managing tokens, and enforcing access control for protected features like video uploads and interactions.

tags.name: Videos
tags.description: The **Videos folder** contains endpoints for managing video-related tasks such as uploading, retrieving, and interacting with videos. It supports features like querying videos with filters as well as handling interactions like updating title, description & thumbnail and also toggle the publish status of the video.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: The **Comment folder** contains endpoints for managing comments on videos. It allows users to retrieve all comments for a specific video, add new comments, update existing ones, and delete comments. These operations support user interaction and engagement within the video platform.

tags.name: Likes
tags.description: The **Likes folder** includes endpoints to toggle likes on videos and comments, and to retrieve all videos a user has liked. It supports user engagement by allowing them to like or unlike content and view their liked videos.

tags.name: Playlist
tags.description: The **Playlist folder** contains endpoints for managing playlists. Users can create, update, and delete playlists, retrieve a playlist by its ID, get all their own playlists, and add or remove videos from a playlist. These features help users organize and manage their video collections on the platform.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: The **Subscription folder** includes endpoints to manage channel subscriptions. Users can toggle subscriptions to channels, retrieve a list of a channel's subscribers, and get all channels they are subscribed to. These features allow users to manage their subscriptions and keep track of their favorite channels.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: The **Dashboard folder** contains endpoints for retrieving channel-related data. Users can get channel statistics, such as subscriber count and video performance, and retrieve all videos associated with the channel. These features provide channel owners with insights into their content and audience.
